newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates end little changed, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates end little changed, seen stable.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates closed little changed on Tuesday as worries over tight liquidity before the Chinese lunar New Year on February 7 eased, dealers said.
The overnight interbank rate ended at 5.483 percent against Monday's 5.475 close, with the 30-day commercial paper steady at 5.30-5.40 percent against 5.35-5.40.
Liquidity had loosened after the central bank injected postal funds to in the banking system, dealers said.
The bond market was dull in the afternoon. Market sentiment would remain cautious before Friday's auction of 10-year construction bonds, dealers said. -- Rachel Lee (5080815)
